snippet.title: Arknights: Endfield Companionship Celebration & Core Chapter [Homecoming] Version Trailer
snippet.description:
The rift is an unblinking eye on the land, fixed upon every soul who could not turn back. 
March to the pulse of our homeland, against all tides and currents. 
Set forth with the vow of homecoming, across a decade of distance.
